categories.main_business_segments: Tah Hsin Industrial Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing of electric fans and related household appliances. The company focuses on various types of fans including ceiling fans, table fans, and other ventilation products. It also engages in the production of components and parts related to these appliances.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced motor and blade design technologies to enhance energy efficiency and noise reduction in its fan products. Manufacturing processes emphasize precision assembly and quality control to ensure product durability and performance. Tah Hsin also integrates smart control technologies in some product lines to meet modern consumer demands.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tah Hsin serves both domestic and international markets, targeting household consumers, commercial establishments, and industrial clients requiring ventilation solutions. Its products are distributed through retail channels, wholesalers, and direct sales to businesses. The company’s major markets include Taiwan, Southeast Asia, and other global regions where demand for electric fans is significant.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities and offices located in Taichung and Taipei. It exports products to various countries across Asia, including Southeast Asia, and has a presence in global markets through distributors and partners. The geographic coverage reflects a focus on both local and international sales channels.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tah Hsin operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembly of electric fans and related appliances. It sources raw materials and components from upstream suppliers and delivers finished products to retailers and end consumers. The company manages product design, production, and distribution within its supply chain scope.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes research and development in energy-efficient motor technology, noise reduction, and smart appliance integration. Innovation efforts include developing environmentally friendly products compliant with international standards such as RoHS. Tah Hsin also emphasizes sustainability and ESG initiatives in its strategic R&D direction to enhance corporate responsibility and market competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Tah Hsin generates revenue primarily through the sale of electric fans and household appliances. Sales channels include wholesale distribution, retail partnerships, and direct business-to-business transactions. The company’s revenue is product-based, with occasional licensing or OEM manufacturing arrangements contributing to income streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other electric fan and small appliance manufacturers both domestically and internationally. Tah Hsin positions itself as a quality-focused manufacturer with strong R&D capabilities and a broad product portfolio. Its competitive advantages include technological innovation, product reliability, and established distribution networks.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Tah Hsin reported annual revenues around NT$2.1 billion with a slight decrease compared to the previous year, indicating a stable but challenging market environment. The company maintains a solid asset base and continues to invest in R&D and production capacity. Growth prospects focus on expanding international market share and enhancing product value through innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tah Hsin emphasizes product quality, energy efficiency, and noise reduction as key differentiators. The company offers a diverse range of fan products tailored to various consumer needs, including smart features and compliance with environmental standards. Its value proposition centers on delivering reliable, innovative, and eco-friendly ventilation solutions to customers.
